lesson_title: REST APIs, CRUD Operations, and Request Validation

questions.question: Which HTTP method is most appropriate for creating a new job entry in a REST API?
options: GET
POST
DELETE
PATCH

questions.question: Why is this create-job endpoint unsafe or incomplete?
options: POST routes cannot read req.body
There is no validation, so empty or malformed job data can still be inserted
res.json() must be replaced with res.sendFile()
jobs.push() only works in async functions

questions.question: What is wrong with this update route for a specific job?
options: PUT routes cannot send JSON
The route path does not include :id, so req.params.id will be undefined
Updates must use GET instead of PUT
req.params only works with DELETE

questions.question: In a REST-style API, which route shape is usually best for fetching one job by id?
options: /getJob?id=7
/jobs/all/7
/jobs/7
/fetch/jobs?id=7

questions.question: Why is this validation check broken?
options: The condition only fails when both are missing; it should likely reject if either required field is missing
status(400) cannot be used for validation
Validation must happen after res.json()
Logical operators cannot be used in Express

questions.question: What is the main issue with this delete route?
options: filter() returns a new array, but the result is not assigned back, so nothing is actually deleted
DELETE routes cannot use filter()
req.params.id is always a number in Express
res.json() prevents deletion from happening

questions.question: What status code is usually appropriate when a resource is created successfully?
Why can this route behave unpredictably when ids are numbers?
options: req.params.id is a string, so strict comparison can fail if item.id is stored as a number
find() cannot be used in route handlers
res.json() only accepts arrays
Route params are always booleans

questions.question: Why is this PATCH route not partially updating anything?
options: job is declared as const from find() and then reassigned; also the updated object is not written back into the data source
PATCH cannot be used with req.body
Spread syntax is invalid in Express
Partial updates require DELETE first

questions.question: Why is request validation important in an API?
options: It helps reject bad input before it damages data flow or causes downstream errors
It automatically creates database tables
It replaces authentication
It makes every route faster by default

questions.question: What is the problem with this not-found handling?
options: After sending the 404 response, the code should return; otherwise it may try to send another response
404 cannot be used inside GET routes
find() already sends a response automatically
res.json(job) must always come before all conditions

questions.question: Why is this validation middleware not protecting the POST /jobs route?
options: When validation passes, next() is never called, so the route handler never runs
Middleware cannot be used on POST routes
req.body.title should be req.params.title
201 responses require GET requests
